items.question: I'd like to schedule my next appointment, please.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“I'd like to schedule my next appointment, please.”，自然应答是“OK, does Monday work for you?”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（OK, does Monday work for you?）。
